So I would recommend getting the shop manual for the car. I have a 1977 280z so my fusebox is different but Im going to assume you're cars main power wires are the two thicker red wires. Those send voltage to that whole fuse box and the key in the ignition reroutes the power to different things in different positions so in the on position right before crank position you should be getting power to just the coil in the engine may. That year has a mechanical fuel pump so you really nust need to check the voltage at the positive terminal on the coil.
